name: exact_gasfree testnet (TRON Nile, real chain settlement via GasFree relayer)

steps.name: start example facilitator
steps.command: @start_bg facilitator env FACILITATOR_PORT=8013 FACILITATOR_TRON_PRIVATE_KEY=${TRON_NILE_FACILITATOR_KEY} FACILITATOR_TRON_NETWORKS=tron:nile FACILITATOR_TRON_SCHEMES=exact_gasfree GASFREE_API_URL=${GASFREE_NILE_API_URL} TRON_NILE_RPC_URL=${TRON_NILE_RPC_URL} python3 -m examples.facilitator

steps.name: start resource server (exact_gasfree on TRON Nile)
steps.command: @start_bg resource-server env E2E_NETWORK=tron:nile E2E_SCHEMES=exact_gasfree E2E_SERVER_PORT=8012 E2E_FACILITATOR_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8013 E2E_PAY_TO=${TRON_NILE_PAY_TO} E2E_ASSET_PRICE=${TRON_NILE_GASFREE_PRICE} python3 -m e2e.servers.resource_server

steps.name: client: pay via GasFree relayer (real on-chain settlement)
steps.command: env E2E_NETWORK=tron:nile E2E_SCHEMES=exact_gasfree E2E_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8012 E2E_ENDPOINT=/protected E2E_TRON_PRIVATE_KEY=${TRON_NILE_CLIENT_KEY} E2E_GASFREE_API_URL=${GASFREE_NILE_API_URL} E2E_OUTPUT=/tmp/x402-e2e-exact-gasfree-testnet-response.json E2E_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=180 python3 -m e2e.clients.test_client

steps.name: assert payment succeeded + tx hash present
